args.question: Please provide the cardholder statement, including the dispute details and any communication about the goods or services.

args.reason: Cardholder says the order never arrived and the merchant holds no product description or delivery proof to rebut it; terms and receipt alone do not answer a non-receipt claim, and arbitration fees would add loss at low odds.

args.explanation: Seed 5003. Reason 4853 (goods not as described / defective); cardholder statement says the order never arrived. Read terms acceptance, receipt and authorization record. The required product description and delivery proof were not held, so I did not represent. Accepted liability on the chargeback. Ledger: chargeback 9232 and chargeback fee 1500. No refund issued (no double refund).
